seeds.sg-3-1-0-0: In the humming blue corridors of the Shard Bazaar, a toothless merchant murmurs that the Rain Vault is empty and dry.
seeds.sg-3-1-0-1: Beneath a leaning arcade of green glass, a desperate smuggler insists the Rain Vault is already guarded by the Salt Court.
seeds.sg-3-1-1-0: You slip past a collapsed obsidian balcony where scavengers bicker over copper wire, risking a fall into the singing pits.
seeds.sg-3-1-1-1: A blind scavenger named Oren barters for your spare flint while leaning against a pillar of fused teal crystal.
seeds.sg-3-1-1-2: Amidst the debris of a mirror-maker's workshop, a jagged shard reflects the scorching noon glare directly into your eyes.
seeds.sg-3-1-1-3: Walking unguided, you notice a fresh bootprint in the salt dust leading straight into a hidden drainage conduit.
seeds.sg-3-1-1-4: A toll-lord's scout peers from a high window of smoked glass, forcing you to duck behind a crumbling arch.
seeds.sg-3-1-1-5: The air grows heavy with the smell of scorched resin as you cross a bridge made of woven copper wire.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-0: In a courtyard of shattered crystal bells, a lone beggar named Sola begs for water while clutching a broken sextant.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-1: You crawl through a low tunnel of purple slag where the floor hums with strange, subterranean vibrations.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-2: Moving without a companion allows you to spot an unsecured winch that lifts you cleanly over a toll barrier.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-3: A team of Glasswright apprentices argue noisily over the refractive index of a massive lens-block suspended above you.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-4: You balance precariously on a narrow rib of twisted lead high above a chasm of razor-sharp quartz needles.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-5: A sudden flash from a distant signal-tower blinds you momentarily, masking your scramble behind a basalt pillar.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-6: Salt-encrusted wind chimes clatter mournfully in a ruined conservatory where nothing green has grown for centuries.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-7: You trade a mouthful of brackish water for shelter beneath the velvet canopy of an itinerant carpet-weaver.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-8: A forgotten doorway of amber glass groans ominously as shifting thermal currents threaten to shatter it.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-9: You navigate a labyrinth of hollow pillars that whistle a low, haunting note every time the wind stirs.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-10: A group of fierce Dune Sisters block a sunlit courtyard, demanding an oath before letting you pass their well.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-11: You scramble over a mountain of discarded spectacle frames that clatter like dry bones beneath your heavy boots.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-12: A hooded scavenger named Kael offers to trade a counterfeit map of Prism for your sturdy wool cloak.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-13: You slip through an abandoned larder smelling faintly of dried lemons and centuries-old vinegar.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-14: A rusted iron crane swings dangerously overhead, its dangling chain scraping against the calcified pavement.
seeds.sg-3-1-2-15: You duck into a sunken alcove of amethyst glass while a patrol of toll-lords marches past with heavy pikes.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-0: In a plaza of fractured sunstones, a frantic courier begs you to carry a warning about poisoned cisterns.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-1: You squeeze through a narrow fissure in a wall of fused green bottles, tearing your sleeve on jagged glass.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-2: A skeletal street-cleaner named Miri sweeps sparkling glass dust into neat piles with a twig broom.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-3: You cross a suspension bridge woven from copper wire that hums like a hornet's nest beneath your feet.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-4: An old woman selling roasted salt-crusts warns you that the signal-towers are sending coded warnings tonight.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-5: You hide inside a hollow cistern of black basalt while heavy footsteps echo loudly on the glass overhead.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-6: Unburdened by debts or allies, you negotiate a swift passage with a rogue cart-driver for a single copper coin.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-7: A jagged chasm splits the street, forcing you to leap across a void of glittering crystal shards.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-8: You trade a handful of dried dates with a weary scholar for directions around the central toll-fort.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-9: A flock of white-feathered gulls nests strangely atop a scorched pillar of iridescent slag.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-10: You wade through a shallow pool of salty brine that stings the open blisters on your travel-weary feet.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-11: A towering archway of engraved crystal frames a breathtaking view of the distant, silent Prism.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-12: You pull yourself up a vertical drainage pipe encrusted with stubborn barnacles of white salt.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-13: A cautious glass-cutter named Bram shares a cup of bitter tea while warning you of traps ahead.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-14: You navigate a collapsing gallery where thousands of tiny prisms scatter the moonlight into blinding rainbows.
seeds.sg-3-1-3-15: A rusted iron gate blocks the alley, its lock rusted solid by decades of alkaline desert winds.
seeds.sg-3-1-4-0: Beneath a canopy of shattered stained glass, you dodge a falling fragment that shatters into deadly dust.
seeds.sg-3-1-4-1: A lone sentry named Vane peers through a brass telescope, ignoring your presence as you dart past.
seeds.sg-3-1-4-2: You squeeze behind a massive fallen sun-disc that blocks the mouth of a hidden subterranean stairwell.
seeds.sg-3-1-4-3: The salty wind howls through a canyon of hollow glass towers, nearly knocking you off your balance.
seeds.sg-3-1-4-4: You scramble across a slippery incline of fused blue slag while distant drums signal an approaching patrol.
seeds.sg-3-1-4-5: A nervous broker named Jora tries to sell you an ineffective talisman against the coming monsoon floods.
seeds.sg-3-1-4-6: You slip through an unguarded postern gate built into the massive outer wall of the old lens-foundry.
seeds.sg-3-1-4-7: The path narrows to a knife-edge of white salt, with the dark abyss of the basin yawning on either side.
seeds.sg-3-1-5-0: You climb a steep flight of spiralling glass stairs that lead directly toward the humming signal-tower.
seeds.sg-3-1-5-1: A weathered bronze door at the base of the tower stands ajar, letting out a sharp beam of white light.
seeds.sg-3-1-5-2: You dodge a sweeping mirror-flash from the upper gallery, pressing flat against the warm glass wall.
seeds.sg-3-1-5-3: The tower steps ring sharply under your boots as you approach the glowing threshold of the Glasswright's sanctum.
seeds.sg-d-3-1: You attempt to slide down a steep chute of fused glass without a brake, shattering your ember-lamp and plunging yourself into darkness just as the patrol closes in.
